changelog: Merged candidate rules into [When to Segment]: added explicit guidance to delay cutting when adjoining adverbs/quantifiers, only modifiers/determiners are present, locative complements are pending, demonstratives/pronouns may be disambiguated by a following modifier, and when a following parenthetical/appositive or trailing locative can alter meaning. This makes the model wait for disambiguating material rather than finalising prematurely.

Updated [Priority Rules] to rank boundaries adjacent to polarity/quantifier adverbs, immediately after modifier-only stretches, before locative complements, before demonstrative-disambiguating modifiers, and around ambiguous-attachment modifiers as lower-confidence; clarified that comma-appositive cuts are low priority unless the following token is an unambiguous finite verb. This implements the critic's measured failures by demoting risky positions rather than banning them.

Expanded [Decision Procedure] local safety checks to demote (not delete) candidates matching the high-risk surface patterns from the candidate rules: adverb/quantifier-adjacent cuts, modifier-only cuts (no head yet), locative-complement cuts, demonstrative/pronoun-disambiguation cuts, ambiguous-attachment modifiers, and boundaries before parentheticals/final locatives; retained the existing numeric/unit, first-conjunct and colon-list checks. This keeps risky candidates available but ranked low so safer boundaries survive tight budgets.
